- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained negatively geared properties have rental income less than expenses, while positively geared properties have rental income exceeding expenses. It stated that positively geared properties are generally considered more valuable in Australia due to providing a steady income stream, but it also depends on the investor's strategy and goals.

- [USER] User asked how many times the Kansas City Chiefs have played the Jacksonville Jaguars.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant stated that as of knowledge cut-off in 2021, the Chiefs and Jaguars have played 23 times since 1995, with the Chiefs winning 14 games and the Jaguars winning 9 games.

- [USER] User asked how many of those 12 games in Kansas the Chiefs won.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirmed that the Chiefs won 10 out of the 12 games played in Kansas against the Jaguars.
